## Highlights since 0.18.0

- **A native Lattice on Apple silicon Macs.** On a Mac with Apple silicon, this update replaces Lattice with its native version, drawn by the Mac's graphics hardware instead of a web page. It looks and works the way Lattice did. Your recent projects, settings, themes, plugins, project templates, Agent skills and Overleaf links come with it, and it keeps updating itself as before. The data of the previous version stays where it was, untouched. Intel Macs, Windows and Linux keep the current Lattice.
- **Spell check in the native Lattice.** The native Lattice checks spelling in .tex, Markdown and text files with macOS's own spell checker, in the language macOS detects for each paragraph, so Chinese prose is never marked. Right-click a marked word for suggestions, Ignore Spelling or Learn Spelling. Words in the project dictionary are left alone, and Settings › Editor & builds › Check spelling turns the check off. Grammar checking and the dictionaries for other languages are not part of the native version.
- **Lattice Beta is now Lattice.** If you tried Lattice Beta, you can delete it: Lattice is now the same app. Lattice Beta keeps its own data and gets no more updates.
